title: Quick Garlic Tomato Pasta
instructions: 1. Boil pasta. 2. Sauté garlic and tomatoes in olive oil. 3. Toss pasta with sauce.
substitutions: Use canned tomato sauce if fresh tomatoes are unavailable.
tips: Add red pepper flakes for extra heat.

title: Vegetable Stir Fry
instructions: 1. Sauté garlic and vegetables in oil. 2. Stir in soy sauce. 3. Serve hot over cooked rice.
substitutions: Replace rice with noodles or quinoa.
tips: Keep the heat high for crisp vegetables.
